title: Brokered HTTP Client

allowlist.description: Requests are denied unless the destination host is in the declared allowlist.
allowlist.claim_boundary: The local contract enforces an in-memory allowlist; live provider hosts are declared by later manifests. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

tls.description: Non-HTTPS destinations are rejected except an explicit insecure-localhost override for tests.
tls.claim_boundary: Certificate pinning, trust stores, and real provider TLS are deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

redirect_policy.description: Redirect responses are refused rather than followed to an undeclared destination.
redirect_policy.claim_boundary: No redirect re-evaluation against the allowlist is performed; redirects fail closed. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

header_redaction.description: Sensitive request headers are redacted before being written to the audit trail.
header_redaction.claim_boundary: Audit is in-memory for this local contract; production log sinks remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

timeout.description: Every request is bounded by a timeout and fails closed with a typed error.
timeout.claim_boundary: No adaptive or provider-specific timeout tuning is applied locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

cancel.description: An in-flight request can be aborted by its request id.
cancel.claim_boundary: Cancellation is best-effort for the local client; upstream provider cancellation semantics are deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

response_limit.description: Response bodies larger than the configured byte limit are rejected.
response_limit.claim_boundary: Streaming and chunked provider payloads above the limit are not buffered locally. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.

claim_boundary: This is a local brokered HTTP contract, not a live provider integration.
No provider endpoint, certificate, proxy, or credential is exercised by this contract.
Live network, provider connectivity, and external security evidence remain deferred. DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
